Data.String: E-404A/B falling film, once through, E-404B at 20 kPa(a) (D-008, D-009, Q14 11.0 MW, Q15 13.1 MW); LIC-4604 and LIC-4616 hold the sumps; PIC-4610 sets the speed of K-461A/B. Condensates S28 to V-461: recycle S29 on LIC-4615, purge S30 on FIC-4614.

T-401A/B and T-402: LSHH-4809A/B and LSHH-4705 close XV-4807A/B and XV-4704 (C&E I-401 to I-403). FFIC-4701 holds the ethanol make-up S17 in ratio to the acid feed of R-401 (D-008). T-402 ethanol, N2 blanketed: flammable area (D-012).
